exploratory_google_covariation.reviewer_readout: Observed Google whole-call window marginal medians were doh_warm: 32.106 to 47.872 ms (range 15.766); udp_fresh: 36.447 to 37.478 ms (range 1.031); udp_bound: 28.861 to 39.207 ms (range 10.346). These ranges show variation in measured client-and-service timings, but do not identify the responsible network path, cache, resolver, CPU or protocol stage. Per-session centered points and complete window values accompany this readout.
exploratory_google_covariation.scope: Exploratory marginal co-movement after centering each mode's window medians within session. Marginal medians retain all successful records for each treatment; paired contrasts require both matched treatments to succeed, so discordant failures can also change composition. No p-values, independence or causal/mechanism claim; repeated names and only a few selected windows remain.

legacy_positive_google_forecast.target: For EACH follow-up matched measurement window, median of paired established DoH elapsed_ms minus fresh UDP elapsed_ms INCLUDING explicit socket creation and bind setup will be greater than zero. Exact labels: doh_warm minus udp_fresh.
legacy_positive_google_forecast.caveat: The follow-up fresh UDP explicitly binds inside elapsed_ms; the historical client uses implicit bind. This is a prospective sign transport check under an implementation change, not exact validation of an identical estimator or a pure network/cryptography estimate.

reference.note: Historical samples remain separate references. No old/new pooled query estimate is reported.

interpretation: Selected same-evening sessions; no multi-day or network population claim. No across-session confidence/equivalence interval. Within-session paired observations share domains/windows; rates describe retained successful pairs only. Cache/routing/source-port and unobserved conditions prevent mechanism attribution.
